summary: Nora no longer mistakes a street name for where someone is, or recites the clock hours back when saying where they usually are.
details: A place nobody named in Life360 is said as what it is to them, near its street («a place he goes near Main Road»), instead of the street's name alone, which she had read as a road he only drove along.
She names the hours the way a person would («Wednesday evening», «Tuesday morning») instead of repeating «18:00-23:00».
She no longer adds «this is only a forecast, not real-time» to every answer; how sure she is stays in the words («should», «probably», «maybe»).
Asked how sure, she names the one or two most common places with roughly how much of the time, and sums up the rest.
limitations: A place is still only as well named as Life360 knows it; a saved place name is always used as is.
